name: Nadia Proust
original_name: ナディア・プルースト
source:
[i]"Brother... Isn't this the kind of thing you'd call 'fate'?"[/i]

Lucas's younger sister. She is cheerful and loves talking about romance. She has been living in the hospital for treatment of an unknown physical ailment, which makes it impossible for her to walk on her own. Her current concern is that her brother hasn't shown much interest in romantic relationships.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/vircheevermore/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
